This project is a FastAPI backend for document remediation. It processes .docx and .pptx files, extracts images and context, and uses CrewAI and ACP for agent-based document summarization, image classification, and alt text generation. Prioritize modular, agent-oriented code and clear API endpoints for file upload, image/context retrieval, alt text update, and download.
